name: Petey Mac
subject: Same Same But Different Festival Reveals Pre-Party, Daily Lineups & More
message: Same Same But Different Festival Reveals 2026 Daily Stage Lineups Five Stages, a Private Island, Late-Night Takeovers and Three Days of Genre-Bending Music Set the Schedule for SSBD's 2026 Return Apply For Press Credentials Here <https://www.ssbdfest.com/volunteer-positions/general-inquiries> Sep 25-27, 2026 Lake Perris, CA SSBDFEST.COM <http://www.ssbdfest.com> Download Flyer + Photos Here  <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1U3CgxozyaOWJPAkq3LfdokwZbGGv77nC?usp=sharing> FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE September 14, 2026 San Diego, CA – Same Same But Different Festival (SSBD) has revealed the daily stage lineups for its 2026 edition, giving fans a first look at how three days of genre-bending music, immersive programming, and unexpected experiences will unfold across Lake Perris, CA September 25–27, with an official pre-party kicking things off Thursday, September 24. SSBD’s 2026 edition returns with a tightly curated lineup led by Of The Trees, LSDREAM, Gramatik, and Tape B, alongside standout acts including Andy Frasco & The U.N., Machinedrum, Diggin Dirt, Kasablanca, KLO, Ship Wrek, TRUTH, Chef Boyarbeatz b2b Contra, Lee Reynolds, Thought Process, Vincent Antone, Effin, WonkyWilla & Strawberry Disco Circus, and more. Rather than simply moving from stage to stage, SSBD is designed as a collection of distinct worlds each with its own sound, personality, and surprises. Thursday, September 24 – The Official SSBD Pre-Party SSBD officially kicks off Thursday, September 24 with its pre-party, presented by Tiger Fox <https://www.instagram.com/tigerfoxpresents.sd/> , the San Diego-based collective known for curating unique immersive music and dance experiences. The opening night features Saturna, Thought Process, Burnsun b2b KiLO, Fiendi, Furtha, Hypho, PANDO!, Shortcvke, and Ursa Major, setting the tone for a weekend built around discovery, community, and dancing well past the expected hours. Friday, September 25 Headliner Of The Trees closes out the Same Stage alongside Effin, Steller, and Vincent Antone, while the But Stage welcomes Big Sis, Les Greene & The Swayzees, Helix Moon, and Tone Ranger. At Tikis' Coco Cove, Lee Reynolds, Nariman, Peace Control, Danny Grisa, Grace Seymour, Gkat, JustJoe & Friends, and Novodor take over for a late-night journey continuing until 5 a.m. Meanwhile, the Inner Bass Stage's Good Society programming features Fendi, Furtha, Hypho, Casey Club, and Zoska. Saturday, September 26 Saturday brings two of the festival's biggest names together on the Same Stage – LSDREAM and Gramatik – joined by Kasablanca and Koastle (live). Elsewhere, the But Stage features Diggin Dirt, Strawberry Disco Circus, Arts & Crafts, and The VROS, while Good Society brings KLO, Bass Temple, Hyperlight, Kaipora, Mocha, and BabyKush to the Inner Bass Stage. Tikis' Coco Club keeps things moving with Ship Wrek, Twin Diplomacy, CONRXD, Geo Smith (live), Juush, Lumi, Marta, and Trés Mortimer. Sunday, September 27 Sunday closes the festival with Tape B, Andy Frasco & The U.N., and TRUTH on the Same Stage, the But Stage closes out with No Suits, Misa James, and The Floridians, while Good Society features Chef Boyarbeatz b2b Contra, WonkyWilla & Strawberry Disco Circus, and Daggz. At Coco Club, the final day brings Lusid, Mishell, Yamagucci, Izzy Wise (live), Lidija x Monción, MNTRA, Sosh & Mosh (live), and The Botanist. The Festival Within The Festival: Nakey Island Beyond the five main stages, SSBD's daily programming extends across the water to Nakey Island, its private, boat-access-only escape produced in partnership with Southern California creative collective Almost Nakey. Accessible exclusively by boat, Nakey Island operates as its own world throughout the weekend, with hidden beaches, open-air dance floors, cabanas, scenic hiking trails, wellness programming, kayak races, treasure hunts, and a dedicated island stage featuring music that won't be repeated on the main festival grounds. Friday: Curly Brown, Kridder & The Homies, Kyro, Zayda Saturday: Amadeezy, Badtongue b2b Kale, Boo, Dükank b2b Diandra, Machinedrum Sunday: AB3D, Andreasone, Cocoa Crescendo, DJ IJO, FMLY BZNS, Jungle Haüs, Max Web, One Lovell Guests can access the island through the Nakey Island Passport, which includes unlimited ferry rides throughout the weekend. Limitless Passholders already have access included. Beyond the music, SSBD continues to offer more than 75 workshops and experiences, including wellness programming, interactive art, LSDREAM's Lightcode, the Family Garden, Groove Cove, Floatopia, a hot air balloon experience, and more. For all press related inquiries, please contact: Petey@Pgmpr.com <mailto:Petey@PGMPR.com> Follow SSBD: Website <https://www.ssbdfest.com> | Facebook <https://www.facebook.com/ssbdfest> | Instagram <https://www.instagram.com/ssbdfest> | X <https://www.twitter.com/ssbdfest> | YouTube <https://www.youtube.com/@ssbdfest> About SSBD: SSBD began in 2018, started by a few friends, with a couple hundred attendees and has grown exponentially each year and continues to this day as an independent festival, with no institutional backing. Known for its unique community and the meticulous care put into every aspect, SSBD offers far more than just music. It’s a haven for creativity, connection, and unexpected wonder. Nestled on the beach of Lake Perris, the picturesque landscape creates an enchanting environment that the organizers fill with surprises around every corner.  <https://www.pgmpr.com/?ss_source=sscampaigns&ss_campaign_id=6aa43fc872c6fe0ef920cd57&ss_email_id=6aa821d14aa83812fd9d5281&ss_campaign_name=Same+Same+But+Different+Festival+Reveals+Pre-Party%2C+Daily+Lineups+%26+More&ss_campaign_sent_date=2026-09-14T16%3A33%3A49Z>  <https://www.instagram.com/peteymacpr> Seattle, WA, USA Unsubscribe  <https://campaign-preferences.com/unsubscribe/2PpNpW0_w2h7ihY3P6-axrbl5FTxrUkwmdCOvoZjXWYsD-i2PVNZdUZIeujYWALi9S5KxsNbacAg8njfoyLBgZYgSBuKBow8rQ8LgJkzinIrLU1-K3DyAKWuWBqBEnOsPsgel7fu4kzKjZZ-uBTLII7lPbeyjFaaP5zmCt9bwzAOU0P-3bLCVYm3ICKc6TRtwxo8jYvSlNqaUnymQY7K0JqEwWcAPNLTyu96XV5cn_Lgiyj0WYxs1kt2BItXi8Grn1CFICYP85XG4rcsopcpB7mhtHYhRp1nwYa7me8KObFuioeYoyYcusUID9Z3pGmKb8wb6ZNu9UiNGTTj8d1Tq-me80LrsdPJt2NV9sAZbLwCEtxafBs0mmo=>
